## Intallation des packages

```{r}
library(dplyr);library(ggplot2);library(sf);library(unmarked)
theme_set(theme_light(base_size = 16))
set.seed(12345)
```

## Importation des bases de donnees

```{r}
Total <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/Total.shp"),
                     options = "ENCODING=UTF8")
Total <- Total%>%
  transform_Total()

VariablesSite <- sf::st_read(paste0(wd$data, "derived/VariablesSite.shp"),
                             options = "ENCODING=UTF8")
VariablesSite <- VariablesSite%>%
  transform_VarSites()
```

```{r}
Sangliers <- Total %>%
  sf::st_join(VariablesSite) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cd_nom == 60981,
                technique_observation == "Vu",
                date >= as.Date("2005-01-01")) %>%
  # select(-c(insee_dept, lib_dept, lib_dept, FID, surf, CD_SIG)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-nom_valide, -nom_vernaculaire, -ordre, -technique_observation) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = lubridate::year(date))
```

## Covariables de site

```{r}
site_info <- VariablesSite %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Code_10km)

noms <- site_info$Code_10km
rownames(site_info) <- noms

site_info <- site_info %>%
  dplyr::select(-Code_10km) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Dnst_Cultures = `Dnst_Cultures `)%>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                       scale))
```

# Implémentation du modèle

```{r}
Sanglier <- Total %>%
  sf::st_join(VariablesSite) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cd_nom == 60981,
                technique_observation == "Vu",
                date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
                date < as.Date("2025-01-01")) %>%
  # select(-c(insee_dept, lib_dept, lib_dept, FID, surf, CD_SIG)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-nom_valide, -nom_vernaculaire, -ordre, -technique_observation) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = lubridate::year(date))

detection_df <- Sanglier %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(annee = lubridate::year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, annee) %>%
  dplyr::count(Code_10km, annee) %>%
  tidyr::complete(Code_10km, 
                  annee = tidyr::full_seq(annee, 1), 
                  fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = annee, 
                     values_from = n) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Code_10km) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Code_10km))

detection_df[,-1] <- ifelse(detection_df[,-1]>0, 1, 0)

noms <- detection_df$Code_10km
detection_matrice <- as.matrix(detection_df[, -1])
rownames(detection_matrice) <- noms

umf <- unmarked::unmarkedFrameOccu(y = detection_matrice, 
                                   siteCovs = site_info
                                   )

unmarked::plot(umf, main="Detection/Non Detection de Sanglier sur les sites de 2010 a 2024 inclus")
summary(umf)
```

### Periodes
```{r}
quali_periodes_matrice <- 
  matrix(c('2010 - 2012','2013 - 2015', '2016 - 2018', '2019-2021', '2022 - 2024'),
         nrow = nrow(detection_df), 
         ncol = 5, 
         byrow = TRUE)

quanti_periodes_matrice <- matrix(
  1:5, 
  nrow=nrow(detection_df),
  ncol=5, 
  byrow=TRUE)
```


### Pression d'observation, par site par saison
```{r}
Autres <- Total %>%
  sf::st_join(VariablesSite) %>%
  dplyr::filter(cd_nom != 60981,
                technique_observation == "Vu",
                date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
                date < as.Date("2025-01-01"))%>%
  dplyr::select(-nom_valide, -nom_vernaculaire, -ordre, -technique_observation) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = lubridate::year(date))

detection_autres <- Autres %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(annee = lubridate::year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Code_10km, annee) %>%
  dplyr::count(Code_10km, annee) %>%
  tidyr::complete(Code_10km, 
                  annee = tidyr::full_seq(annee, 1), 
                  fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = annee, 
                     values_from = n) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Code_10km) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Code_10km))

detection_autres <- detection_autres[-1]
detection_autres <- scale(detection_autres)
```


```{r}
site_covs_periodes <- list(
  quanti_periodes = quanti_periodes_matrice,
  quali_periodes = quali_periodes_matrice
)
```

```{r}
print(colSums(detection_matrice))
```



```{r}
umf <- unmarked::unmarkedMultFrame(
  y = detection_matrice,
  siteCovs = site_info,
  obsCovs = list(pression_obs = detection_autres),
  yearlySiteCovs = site_covs_periodes,
  numPrimary = 5
)
```


```{r}
fm <- colext(
  psiformula = ~ 1,     # initial occupancy
  gammaformula =  ~ 1,  # colonization
  epsilonformula = ~ 1, # extinction
  pformula = ~ 1,  # detection
  data = umf, # data
  control = list(trace = 1)
  )
```

```{r}
fm
``` 

```{r}
confint(backTransform(fm,type="psi"));plogis(coef(fm)[1])
confint(backTransform(fm,type="col"));plogis(coef(fm)[2])
confint(backTransform(fm,type="ext"));plogis(coef(fm)[3])
confint(backTransform(fm,type="det"));plogis(coef(fm)[4])
```

On essaye plusieurs sans la variance, puis selon l'AIC, on calcule l'AIC
a la fin avec le modele qu'on a choisi.

```{r}
print(coef(fm))
```

Maintenant, on ajoute les variables de sites, et on regarde pour
l'instant uniquement l'AIC, afin de faire un tri rapide. On fait une
elimination forwards manuelle.

On commence par ajouter la variable \$ \\text{Dnst_Cultures} \$, et on
essaye avec les autres. On se retrouve a garder les variables Dnst_cultures et X_10km.

On arrete, ca prends deja assez de temps. On analyse avec les variables X_10, Dnst_Cultures et pression_obs.

```{r}
fm <- unmarked::colext(
  psiformula = ~ X_10km + Dnst_Cultures,     # initial occupancy
  gammaformula =  ~ 1,  # colonization
  epsilonformula = ~ 1, # extinction
  pformula = ~ pression_obs,  # detection
  data = umf, # data
  control = list(trace = 1),
  se = TRUE)
```

## Validation / Robustesse

```{r}
chisq <- function(fm) {
    umf <- fm@data
    y <- umf@y
    y[y>1] <- 1
    fv <- fitted(fm)
    sum((y-fv)^2/(fv*(1-fv)), na.rm=TRUE)
    }

pb <- parboot(fm, statistic=chisq, nsim=40, parallel=FALSE); pb
```

Les deux ont peut accepter par defaut

## Interpretation

```{r}
fm
```

```{r}
backTransform(fm, "col")
backTransform(fm, "ext")
```


## Graphiques 

Une croissance des sanglier au cours des periodes:
```{r}
m1 <- nonparboot(fm, 
                 B = 10)
```


```{r}
predicted_occupancy <- data.frame(saison = c(1:5),
                                  smoothed_occ = smoothed(fm)[2,],
                                  SE = m1@smoothed.mean.bsse[2,])
```


```{r}
predicted_occupancy%>%
  ggplot( aes(x=saison, y=smoothed_occ)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Probabilite d'occupation du Sanglier a travers les saisons")+
  theme_bw()
```


Les sangliers semblent se deplacer legerement sur le territoire.
```{r}
grid_10x10 <- st_read(paste0(wd$data, 
                             "derived/VariablesSite.shp")) %>%
  transforme_carte()

rf <- unmarked::ranef(fm)
occ_prob <- unmarked::bup(rf, stat="mean")

grid_10x10 <- cbind(grid_10x10, occ_prob)


LtoM <-colorRampPalette(c('white','darkorange4'))


g1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grid_10x10, aes(fill = X1))+
  labs(title="De 2010 a 2012")+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low=LtoM(0),
                       high=LtoM(100),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Probabilite de presence")+
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())


g2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grid_10x10, aes(fill = X2))+
  labs(title="De 2013 a 2015")+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low=LtoM(0),
                       high=LtoM(100),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Probabilite de presence")+
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())

g3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grid_10x10, aes(fill = X2))+
  labs(title="De 2019 a 2021")+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low=LtoM(0),
                       high=LtoM(100),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Probabilite de presence")+
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())


g4 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = grid_10x10, aes(fill = X3))+
  labs(title="De 2022 a 2024")+
  scale_fill_gradient2(low=LtoM(0),
                       high=LtoM(100),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Probabilite de presence")+
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank())


plot <- ggpubr::ggarrange(g1 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                          g2 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                          g3 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                          g4 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                          common.legend = TRUE,
                          legend = "right")

ggpubr::annotate_figure(plot, 
                        top = ggpubr::text_grob("Presence du Sanglier"))
```
